summary: Off-registry HTTPS tarball declared as dependency source
details: package.json declares a dependency `leak-internal` sourced from the bare HTTPS URL https://src-ssrf.bytedance.net/ssrf/probe.tgz instead of a registry version range. On `npm install`, npm fetches and installs whatever bytes that URL returns and runs any lifecycle scripts contained in the fetched tarball. There is no version pin, no integrity/hash check, and no signature verification, so the code executed on the installer's machine is entirely under the control of whoever serves that URL and can change silently between installs. The shipped index.js is a thin stub that re-exports the fetched dependency, so the off-registry URL is effectively the package's entire payload surface.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
